body: Founder: 'update the readme including how we can dev plugins for our server.' Not written blind: set up Maven without root (apt-download + dpkg-deb -x, same pattern as the earlier JDK install), wrote a real example plugin (industrial.einhorn.exampleplugin.ExamplePlugin) against the exact paper-api build the live server runs (26.1.2.build.74-stable, checked against PaperMC's real Maven metadata since the version scheme differs from older Paper), built it with Maven, deployed it into the live server via systemctl restart, confirmed in server.log it actually loaded and ran ('[ExamplePlugin] Enabling ExamplePlugin v1.0.0'), then removed the test jar and kept the source as plugins/example-plugin/, the documented starting point. Commits 2580dee/094580a.
title: Real, verified plugin-dev workflow documented (README)
